origin.description: Report whether an object is a piece of captured source.
origin.details: True for the source objects evaluate stores, including a comment line.
origin.example:
ev <- evaluate("# x")
cat("A comment is source:", is.source(ev[[1]]), "\n")
cat("Text is not:", is.source("x"), "\n")

translation.description: Report whether an object is a piece of captured source.
translation.details: True for the source objects evaluate stores, including a comment line.
translation.example:
print("A comment is source:", is_source(evaluate("# x", envir={})[0]))
print("Text is not:", is_source("x"))
